title: Jacket potatoes with celery, apple and walnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, celery, apples, walnuts, Greek yoghurt, Stilton and watercress are all plain whole foods a grandparent would have kept.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including Stilton and watercress, is an everyday line at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only an oven, a tray, a bowl, a knife and a grater for the zest are needed, with no tricky technique.

works.reason: Four potatoes at 200°C for 75 minutes will be crisp and cooked, and the filling quantities suit four, with lemon and Stilton giving plenty of seasoning.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to prick and oil the potatoes, slice the celery, dice the apples, chop the chives and zest the lemon, and the 75-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Crunchy raw celery is the heart of the cool filling, which suits an August lunch, with early apples and fresh watercress alongside.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a neighbour would give, with no fuss or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Jacket potatoes with fresh veg and fruit, yoghurt, cheese and nuts make a filling, balanced family lunch.
